author: TEDx Talks
description:
What happens when the one doctor trained to know your whole story — your history, your family, your fears — disappears? Dr. Marie-Elizabeth Ramas warns that family medicine is facing a crisis that will touch every one of us, and most people won't realize what they've lost until the moment they need it most.

Dr. Marie-Elizabeth Ramas is a family physician with 15 years of experience caring for patients across the full spectrum of life — from birth through end of life, in clinics, hospitals, and homes. As a doctor for largely non-English speaking and underserved communities, she has spent her career at the intersection of public health, advocacy, and whole-person care. A lifelong New Hampshire native, Dr. Ramas has been a voice for health equity and primary care access at the local, state, and national level. She practices what she preaches: she has a family doctor, and she thinks you should too. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently or
title: Are family doctors an endangered species? | Dr. Marie Elizabeth Ramas | TEDxPortsmouth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Arthur Zards, a meaning strategist, argues that progress is making more of our thinking automatic. And as answers become easier to get, choosing can start to replace thinking. Zards challenges us to build a simple thinking system that keeps our thoughts distinctly our own. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at: https://www.ted.com/tedx

Production By: Peaceful Luck Media
Graphics By: Lauren Schultz
 Arthur Zards has spent three decades working where technology, story, and human behavior meet.

In 1992, he co-founded one of Chicago’s first internet service providers, before the web browser existed. He was not studying the internet. He was building it. He became fascinated by a question that has followed him ever since: what happens when a new tool changes not just what we can do, but what we value?

He founded TEDxNaperville and spent fifteen years helping hundreds of speakers uncover the idea
title: Is your thinking garbage?  | Arthur Zards | TEDxArlington Heights

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Phil Jackson, an arts & justice innovator, reveals that art isn't just for kids; it restores and reconstructs identity. Jackson’s heartfelt stories invite you to consider how, when art becomes your weapon of choice, it creates space to reimagine your future within a new identity. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at: https://www.ted.com/tedx.

Production By: Peaceful Luck Media
Graphics By: Lauren Schultz 
 Phil Jackson, founder and pastor, has spent nearly four decades at the intersection of culture and community transformation, building innovative organizations that bridge faith, the arts, and community leadership.

He founded The House Covenant Church, widely known as The House - a groundbreaking hip-hop worship community that earned national recognition and has been featured on BET, MSNBC, PBS, The New York Times, and The Chicago Sun-Times.

He founded The Firehouse Community Arts Center
title: Can art help you find yourself again? | Phil Jackson | TEDxArlington Heights

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Maryam Mehrtash, a narrative strategist, makes the case that every story worth telling exposes tension, and that the stories we can’t stop watching are the ones we avoid telling in our own lives. Through the story of her grandmother, an Iranian Kurdish actress imprisoned for being a storyteller, she offers a simple way to turn toward the polarizing moment and stay in the conversation. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at: https://www.ted.com/tedx.

Production By: Peaceful Luck Media
Graphics By: Lauren Schultz
 Maryam Mehrtash spent nearly two decades inside Hollywood's biggest rooms, building campaigns for Paramount+, CBS, Disney, Marvel Studios, and 20th Century Studios. Her work spanned franchises like Star Trek, Yellowstone, and the GRAMMYs, and global brands from Google and Amazon to VISA and General Motors. A TV Week 40 Under 40 honoree and WIF Business Fellow, she spent years building
title: Why the best stories are polarizing | Maryam Mehrtash | TEDxArlington Heights

Bob Hess, a global location strategist, digs deep into what impacts the odds of your city winning attractive investments. Hess’s heartfelt stories reveal an unexpected factor that can help shape your city’s growth - and what’s at stake when it’s overlooked. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at: https://www.ted.com/tedx.

Graphics By: Lauren Schultz
 Robert Hess is Vice Chairman of Newmark’s Global Occupier Solutions platform and a globally recognized leader in corporate location strategy, site selection, and business strategy. Over a 40-year career, he has led more than 350 projects, advising organizations on complex location and growth decisions. With more than 2.75 million air miles across the globe. 

Robert has held leadership roles as co-founder and Consulting Partner with Cushman & Wakefield’s Global Supply Chain Business Consulting Group and with Del
title: Can Your City Compete Without You?  | Bob Hess | TEDxArlington Heights

author: TEDx Talks
description:
When we talk about nature it’s often referred to as a separate entity, as if we ourselves are not part of the system. Given that we are, how can we blend lived-experience of those closest to this system and new technologies, to ensure we can balance the system for fish and fisher alike? Liberty Denman is a marine biologist, science communicator, and Co-Founder of Kai. Her work focuses on the relationship between people and marine ecosystems, with a particular interest in how knowledge moves between coastal communities, scientists, and decision-makers in the fisheries space. 

Drawing on experience across commercial and recreational fisheries, conservation and research, education and Ocean literacy, diving and marine technology, she examines how different groups understand and respond to change in the Ocean. Her current work explores how the expertise of fishers can be integrated into fisheries management and conservation using purpose-built technology. This talk was given at a TEDx ev
title: How to manage our fisheries with science and lived experience | Liberty Denman | TEDxCapeMay

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk sheds light on the voices that too often go unheard. Every day, many people live with unfair treatment, limited opportunities, and stories that are never given the space to be told. Equality is not only about laws and policies. It is also about listening, understanding, and making sure that no one is left behind simply because of who they are or where they come from. In this talk, Salma Ranggita shares why speaking up matters and how each of us has a role in defending equality, both in big movements and in small everyday actions. Through personal reflections and real experiences, the talk explores how silence can keep injustice alive, while courage and empathy can slowly break down the barriers that divide us. Sometimes, defending equality starts with something as simple as choosing to listen, asking the right questions, or standing beside someone who needs support. Change does not always come from the loudest voices, but from the people who refuse to stay quiet when it matt
title: Voice Unheard: Refending Equality | Salma Ranggita | TEDxTrisakti School of Management

author: TEDx Talks
description: Hayat bazen bizi yeniden başlamaya, alıştığımız sınırların dışına çıkmaya ve kendimizi yeniden inşa etmeye zorlar. Peki, bütün bu değişimlerin içinde kendimiz olarak kalabilmek mümkün mü? 1973 yılında Uşak'ta dünyaya gelmiştir. Bir çocuk annesi olan Özkulak, reklamcılık ve proje danışmanlığı alanlarında çalışmıştır. Meslek hayatında ulusal bir gazetede reklam müdürlüğü yapmış, daha sonra kendi reklam ajansını kurmuştur. Uzun yıllar obeziteyle mücadele eden Özkulak, 110 kilodan 55 kiloya düşerek kendi hayatında önemli bir değişim yaşamıştır. Bu süreçte yaşadığı zorluklardan ve deneyimlerinden yola çıkarak 2018 yılında İzmir'de Obezite ve Sağlıklı Yaşam Fuarı düzenlemiştir. Daha sonra sağlık turizmine yönelerek Türkiye Sağlık Turizmi Derneği İzmir Temsilciliği görevini üstlenmiştir. Ayrıca Türk doktorlarını uluslararası alanda tanıtmak amacıyla Find Doctor in Turkey adlı platformu kurmuştur. author: TEDx Talks
description:
Alberto Cecchini è ingegnere e manager, con un lungo percorso internazionale tra infrastrutture, cooperazione e impegno sociale. Nel Rotary ha ricoperto incarichi di responsabilità a livello nazionale e internazionale, fino a far parte del Board of Directors del Rotary International, affiancando negli anni missioni umanitarie, progetti per l’eradicazione della poliomielite e iniziative dedicate alla pace, è inoltre tra i promotori di Time for Change, progetto che unisce arte, cultura e responsabilità sociale.
Il suo intervento nasce dagli incontri vissuti in Paesi e contesti molto diversi e da una domanda: cosa può realmente cambiare il nostro modo di guardare gli altri e il mondo che ci circonda?
Attraverso persone, luoghi e memorie che hanno segnato il suo percorso, emerge il valore dell’ascolto, dell’attenzione e dell’accoglienza, insieme alla capacità degli incontri di trasformare il nostro punto di vista.
Un viaggio che conduce a interrogarsi su dove cominci davvero la pace e sul
title: L’incontro come forza di cambiamento | Alberto Cecchini | TEDxBellagio

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk challenges the idea that success is measured only by how much money we make. Profit keeps a business alive, but purpose is what gives it meaning. Behind every lasting brand, every loyal customer, and every team that truly believes in what they do, there is a reason that goes deeper than numbers on a financial report. In a world where businesses are judged not only by what they sell but also by the impact they leave, building something that matters has become more important than ever. In this talk, Bryant Kandani shares how purpose can become the foundation for decisions, growth, and long-term success. Through personal experiences and reflections, the talk shows how values, people, and positive impact can work hand in hand with profit instead of standing against it. Every product, every service, and every business decision is a chance to create value that reaches beyond the company itself and makes a real difference in people’s lives. This talk encourages the audience, whethe
title: Purpose Beyond Profit: Building What Matters | Bryant Kandani | TEDxTrisakti School of Management

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Birbirinden farklı seslere hayat verirken aslında kendi hikâyesini yazan Mehmet Dindar, taklit yeteneğinin ardındaki yaşam mücadelesini, hayallerini ve kendini keşfetme yolculuğunu anlatıyor.  Sosyal medyada içerik üreticisi ve komedyendir. Küçük yaşlarda keşfettiği ses taklidi yeteneğini yıllar içinde geliştirerek Türkiye'nin tanınan taklit sanatçılarından biri hâline gelmiştir. 2014 yılında katıldığı yarışma programıyla dikkatleri üzerine çeken Dindar, 200 farklı ses
taklidiyle Guinness Rekorlar Kitabı'na girmiştir. Tanınmış birçok isimlerin yanı sıra çizgi film karakterlerini de seslendirebilmektedir.

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Daniel Tani had the opportunity to see the world from a completely different perspective. What can his experience teach us about our planet and life on Earth? Having spent 132 days in space and completed six spacewalks, Daniel is sharing his experiences at TEDxBelgrade 2026, in a fireside chat with Nemanja Djordjevic, Managing Director of the Miodrag Kostic Endowment – Palace of Science in Belgrade.
|||||
Danijel Tani je imao priliku da vidi svet iz potpuno drugačije perspektive. Šta nas njegovo iskustvo može naučiti o našoj planeti i životu na Zemlji? Astronaut koji je proveo 132 dana u svemiru i izveo šest svemirskih šetnji, podelio je svoja iskustva na TEDxBelgrade 2026, u konverzaciji sa Nemanjom Đorđevićem, upraviteljem Zadužbine Miodraga Kostića - Palate nauke u Beogradu.
 Daniel Tani spent 132 days in space and completed six spacewalks during his 16-year NASA career. He first flew aboard Endeavour on mission STS-108 in 2001, then spent four months aboard the International Space
title: Fireside Chat | Daniel Tani | TEDxBelgrade

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dalija Aćin Thelander invites us to discover what we can learn from the way children experience the world.
Creating theater performances for babies and children with diverse developmental profiles, Dalija opens a space for curiosity, movement and sensory exploration, while challenging our understanding of what it means to attend otherwise.
A talk about different ways of perception, the knowledge we gain through our bodies, and an art form in which everyone can participate at their own pace – at TEDxBelgrade 2026, hosted at the Miodrag Kostic Endowment – Palace of Science.
|||||
Dalija Aćin Telander nas poziva da otkrijemo šta možemo da naučimo iz načina na koji deca doživljavaju svet. Kroz predstave za bebe i decu različitih razvojnih profila, Dalija otvara prostor za radoznalost, pokret i čula, i preispituje našu ideju o tome šta znači učestvovati. 
Govor o različitim načinima opažanja, znanju koje stičemo telom i o umetnosti u kojoj svako može da učestvuje u svom ritmu, na TEDxBelgr
title: The Ecology of Attention: Attending Otherwise | Dalija Aćin Thelander | TEDxBelgrade

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk explores how learning goes far beyond the walls of a classroom. Grades, textbooks, and exams are only one part of the story. Some of the most valuable lessons come from everyday experiences, from the people we meet, the mistakes we make, and the curiosity that pushes us to ask questions no syllabus could ever cover. In a world that changes faster than any curriculum can keep up with, the ability to keep learning on our own has become one of the most important skills we can have. In this talk, Najwa Nur Awalia shares how stepping outside the comfort of formal education can open doors to growth, discovery, and new perspectives. She reflects on how every challenge, every conversation, and every new experience can become a lesson that shapes who we are and who we want to become. Learning does not stop when the bell rings, and it is never limited by age, background, or circumstance. This talk encourages the audience to see learning not as an obligation, but as a lifelong journey
title: Beyond The Classroom: Learning Without Limits | Najwa Nur Awalia | TEDxTrisakti School of Management

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dragana Jevtić knows firsthand that a single conversation can change our life. From her own experience as a mentee to building the Creative Mentorship program and community, her story reminds us how tremendously we can grow when someone recognizes our potential and inspires us to see it in ourselves.
The Power of Mentorship: Transforming Society One Conversation at a Time is a talk about trust, support and the power of shared knowledge that sparks a change – from individuals to entire society – at TEDxBelgrade 2026, hosted at the Miodrag Kostic Endowment – Palace of Science.
|||||
Dragana Jevtić zna koliko samo jedan razgovor može da promeni pravac kojim idemo. Od sopstvenog iskustva mentijke do osnivanja programa Kreativno mentorstvo i zajednice koju okuplja, njena priča nas podseća koliko možemo da porastemo kada neko prepozna naš potencijal i podstakne nas da ga i sami vidimo. Govor o poverenju, podršci i znanju koje, kada se deli, pokreće promene – od pojedinca do čitavog društva,
title: Mentorship: Transforming Society One Conversation at a Time | Dragana Jevtić | TEDxBelgrade

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Immaginare nuovi modi di rispondere alle sfide sociali e trovare gli strumenti per trasformare quelle visioni in cambiamenti reali Progettista sociale laureata in diritti umani, lavora come freelance nella scrittura e ideazione di progetti in ambito sociale e nel Terzo Settore, e nella valutazione di interventi di cooperazione internazionale.

Supporta diverse tipologie di enti nella creazione e gestione di iniziative finanziate attraverso fondi nazionali ed europei.

Il suo lavoro parte dalle idee e dai bisogni delle comunità per trasformarli in proposte concrete ed innovative, individuando risorse e opportunità per renderle realizzabili.

Perché costruire “Mondi Possibili” significa anche questo: immaginare nuovi modi di rispondere alle sfide sociali e trovare gli strumenti per trasformare quelle visioni in cambiamenti reali. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Dare forma alle idee, progettare il cambiamento | Beatrice Malagnini | TEDxPiazzola Sul Brenta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dalle relazioni quotidiane ai grandi modelli d'impresa. Un metodo concreto per dare un futuro solido alle proprie visioni. Con oltre vent’anni di esperienza trasversale, Susanna ha iniziato il proprio percorso professionale nel settore fashion per poi orientare la sua carriera verso la sostenibilità globale e la cooperazione internazionale.

Ha guidato lo sviluppo di partnership e l'espansione internazionale per realtà all'avanguardia come Treedom , collaborando con organizzazioni come Oxfam e affiancando aziende, startup ed enti non profit nella creazione di progetti ad alto impatto concreto su persone e ambiente.

Sul nostro palco porterà una prospettiva pragmatica: un'idea straordinaria, da sola, non basta.

Per aprire autentici Mondi Possibili, un progetto diventa reale solo quando incontra i bisogni reali degli altri, conquista la fiducia delle persone e trova il coraggio di modificare la propria rotta senza tradire l'obiettivo originario.

title: Perché alcune idee cambiano il mondo e altre no | Susanna Finardi | TEDxPiazzola Sul Brenta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Fabio ci mostrerà come la responsabilità sociale d'impresa possa tradursi in azioni tangibili: non servono grandi infrastrutture per generare impatto, ma fiducia, visione e la scelta di considerare la condivisione dello spazio e delle relazioni umane come il vero motore di rinascita locale ed economica. Consulente e formatore di riferimento nel digital advertising e nelle strategie web, Fabio unisce rigore analitico a un forte impegno sociale.

Dalla sua esperienza diretta nasce Otellino, Coworking e Ostello Gratuito, un modello no-profit di ospitalità e spazio di lavoro nei borghi storici, creato per accogliere professionisti, nomadi digitali e giovani freelancer senza barriere economiche.

In un'epoca di lavoro da remoto, isolamento digitale e progressivo spopolamento dei centri storici, quali Mondi Possibili possiamo immaginare per i nostri territori?

title: Come ho aiutato il mio borgo a non morire | Fabio Antichi | TEDxPiazzola Sul Brenta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Dalla Stazione Spaziale Internazionale alla Luna, fino a Marte: cosa succede ai nostri punti di riferimento quando cambiamo prospettiva? Ilaria Fiore ci accompagna oltre l’atmosfera terrestre per scoprire come cambiano ciò che vediamo e lo spazio che abitiamo quando lasciamo il nostro pianeta. Un viaggio in luoghi dove non esistono più un sopra e un sotto, e dove orientarsi significa ripensare il nostro modo di guardare il mondo. Dalla Stazione Spaziale alla Luna, fino a Marte: cosa succede ai nostri punti di riferimento quando cambiamo prospettiva?
Ilaria Fiore, Business Developer e divulgatrice scientifica, sarà tra gli speaker di TEDxApricena – Oltre la Pietra. Alumna dell'International Space University a Houston, dove ha frequentato un programma in collaborazione con la NASA e la Rice University grazie a una borsa di studio dell'Agenzia Spaziale Europea, oggi lavora tra aerospazio, impresa e divulgazione. Come Ambassador di Generazione STEM e STEM Educator racconta alle nuove gene
title: Orientarsi oltre la Terra | Ilaria Fiore | TEDxApricena

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Stefano ci guiderà in un viaggio tra passato, artigianato e futuro, dimostrando come un segno manuale possa ancora connettere le persone e superare i secoli. Ex programmatore informatico, Stefano ha scelto di cambiare radicalmente rotta per riscoprire l'antico mestiere dell'amanuense, fondando lo scriptorium Scritto a Mano nella rocca medievale di Gradara.

Calligrafo mancino che scrive a pagina capovolta per non sbavare l'inchiostro fresco, lavora con pergamena, inchiostri storici e tecniche tradizionali per preservare e tramandare la memoria umana attraverso il gesto lento e artigianale.

In un'epoca di iper-digitalizzazione e velocità istantanea, quali Mondi Possibili si schiudono quando riscopriamo il valore del tempo, della cura e della traccia che lasciamo?

Stefano ci guiderà in un viaggio tra passato, artigianato e futuro, dimostrando come un segno manuale possa ancora connettere le persone e superare i secoli. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference forma
title: L'amanuense e la ricerca del tempo perduto | Stefano Gelao | TEDxPiazzola Sul Brenta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Convincere e Convivere. Il Talk di Adelino Cattani, con la partecipazione di Greta Cedermaz e Alessandro Draghi, ci porterà alle radici della retorica dialogica e costruttiva, offrendoci le chiavi per superare la polarizzazione e costruire ponti attraverso la forza del dirsele (non darsele) di buona e santa ragione. Docente di Teoria dell'argomentazione all'Università di Padova, ha ideato la "Palestra di Botta e Risposta" (www.bottaerisposta.org), il pionieristico progetto di formazione al dibattito argomentato e regolamentato in Italia ed è autore di saggi di riferimento sull'arte della replica e le fallacie.

Il suo insegnamento è ispirato al motto del Disputator Cortese: “Convincere senza rinunciare a convivere”. Non possono esistere Mondi Possibili senza la capacità di dialogare e confrontarsi criticamente.

title: Disputator Cortese | Adelino Cattani, Greta Cedermaz & Alessandro Draghi | TEDxPiazzola Sul Brenta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Hay momentos en la vida que nos cambian para siempre, situaciones que nos obligan a descubrir una nueva forma de vivir. Alejandro viene a compartirnos una historia de transformación, de resiliencia y de una mirada que va mucho más allá de lo que nuestros ojos pueden ver. A veces, cambiar la manera de mirar también significa descubrir todo aquello que antes no veíamos.

A los 21 años recibió un diagnóstico de glaucoma y, después de años de tratamientos e intervenciones, en 2021 perdió la vista. Desde entonces, comenzó un nuevo proceso: recuperar su autonomía, adaptarse y descubrir otras formas de percibir el mundo.

Una historia que parte de una experiencia personal, pero abre una pregunta que puede interpelarnos a todos. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Una mirada diferente | Alejandro Basualdo | TEDxSan Lorenzo

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Una generación puede aprender a deslizar el dedo sobre una pantalla antes de aprender a escribir. Pero ¿cuándo aprende a construir algo propio?
Julián trabaja en ese instante en que la curiosidad se convierte en una idea y alguien se anima a ponerla a prueba. Entre cables, motores y errores,
propone una transformación que empieza en la infancia: descubrir que también podemos crear. ¿Y si la tecnología también pudiera hacernos repensar la forma en que aprendemos?

Su recorrido por la robótica educativa y la tecnología está acompañado por una curiosidad que lo llevó a cuestionar algo que hacemos todos los días: aprender y relacionarnos con nuestro entorno. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: El mito del nativo digital | Julián Petrucci | TEDxSan Lorenzo

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Nos enseñaron a buscar el equilibrio, a encontrar estabilidad, a quedarnos tranquilos. Pero ¿qué pasa si la vida necesita justamente que algo siga moviéndose? Natalia investiga los mecanismos de la vida y sostiene, desde la ciencia argentina, preguntas que exigen tiempo, energía y perseverancia. ¿Qué pasa cuando la ciencia nos invita a cuestionar algo que creemos saber sobre el bienestar? Natalia es científica, investigadora y emprendedora. Su trabajo en Rosario la lleva a estudiar procesos de la vida a escala molecular y a buscar nuevas aplicaciones para ese conocimiento.

Pero, después de años mirando lo que sucede en lo más pequeño, apareció una pregunta capaz de ir mucho más allá del laboratorio. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: No te rompas | María Natalia Lisa | TEDxSan Lorenzo

author: TEDx Talks
description: What lies beneath the surface of the thoughts, emotions, and experiences we struggle to put into words? In Static Beneath The Surface, Zahina Encarnacion explores the complexities of the human experience, particularly the tension between what we feel, what we understand, and what we are able to express. Drawing on philosophical reflection and the nuances of everyday life, she challenges our tendency to seek immediate clarity and simple explanations for experiences that are often deeply layered. Her talk invites audiences to become more comfortable with uncertainty, recognize the meaning within unresolved emotions, and look beyond appearances to better understand themselves and others. Sometimes, understanding begins not with finding an answer, but with learning to listen to what remains beneath the surface. Zahina Encarnacion is a first-year Political Science student at Georgia State University with a deep interest in literature, philosophy, and the complexities of human experience. H
title: Static Beneath The Surface | Zahina Encarnacion | TEDxGeorgiaStateU

author: TEDx Talks
description:
As artificial intelligence makes everyday tasks increasingly effortless, are we gaining efficiency at the expense of our ability to think independently?
In Use It or Lose It: The Dangerous Comfort of AI, Samuel Oriola explores the hidden costs of relying too heavily on technology to think, solve problems, and make decisions for us. Drawing on ideas from neuroscience, data science, and human cognition, he questions how the convenience of AI might influence the cognitive abilities we develop and maintain through active engagement. Rather than rejecting artificial intelligence, Samuel challenges audiences to reconsider their relationship with it, advocating for a more intentional balance between technological assistance and independent thought. His talk raises a timely question: as our machines become smarter, how do we ensure we continue exercising our own intelligence? Samuel Oriola is a second-year Data Science student at Georgia State University, where he actively contributes to stud
title: Use It or Lose It: The Dangerous Comfort of AI | Samuel Oriola | TEDxGeorgiaStateU

author: TEDx Talks
description: Most of us assume other people experience the world roughly the way we do. They don't. Some people think in a near-constant stream of words, while others think primarily in images, sensations, or concepts. Some can summon vivid mental pictures; others see nothing at all. In this talk, we'll explore the hidden diversity of human minds—and how scientists are finally learning to study subjective experience with objective tools. Sadie Dingfelder is a science journalist who is currently obsessed with hidden neurodiversity and science-based answers to the question: If you were beamed into the mind of another person or animal, what would that be like? Her debut book is, “Do I Know you? A Faceblind Reporter’s Journey into the Science of Sight, Memory and Imagination.” This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: The secret diversity of human minds | Sadie Dingfelder | TEDxAsbury Park Salon

author: TEDx Talks
description:
¿Quién decide a qué edad dejamos de empezar?
Hay una manera de mirar la vejez que achica el mundo: reduce las posibilidades, habla por otros y da por terminadas historias que todavía se están escribiendo. Paula y Betty reúnen el conocimiento de la salud y la experiencia de vivir para abrir esa discusión. Porque el deseo de aprender, participar y elegir también tiene futuro. Hay conversaciones que solo pueden surgir cuando dos historias se encuentran.

Hoy presentamos a Paula y Bety, dos oradoras que llegan juntas a INCONFORMISTAS para compartir una experiencia que atraviesa el paso del tiempo, la autonomía, los vínculos y esas ideas que muchas veces aceptamos sin cuestionar.

Sus recorridos son diferentes, pero hay una conversación que las conecta. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Tercer tiempo | María Paula Carbajal Betty Raggo | TEDxSan Lorenzo

author: TEDx Talks
description:
En una carrera larga llega un momento en que la distancia deja de medirse solamente en kilómetros. Aparecen el cansancio, la incertidumbre y una decisión que nadie puede tomar por vos. Hay decisiones que parecen pequeñas, hasta que descubrimos todo lo que pueden transformar.

Lo que comenzó con salir a correr la llevó a convertirse en ultramaratonista y corredora de montaña, enfrentando desafíos de más de 160 kilómetros.

Pero su historia va mucho más allá de la distancia: habla de paciencia, perseverancia, límites y de todo lo que podemos descubrir mientras avanzamos. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: ¿Cuáles son tus 100 metros? | Marina Giménez | TEDxSan Lorenzo

author: TEDx Talks
description: Who gets to decide what makes a human being worthy of dignity? In Rethinking Human Dignity: Who Decides Your Worth?, Nathan Desta challenges the ways society assigns value to individuals based on their circumstances, choices, and place within institutional systems. Drawing on philosophical inquiry and his exposure to the criminal justice system, he explores the tension between how people are judged and the inherent worth they possess. His talk invites audiences to question whether dignity is something that must be earned, granted, or recognized as a fundamental part of being human. By examining the relationship between justice, societal judgment, and individual worth, Nathan encourages us to reconsider how we see and treat one another. Nathan Desta is an undergraduate student of philosophy and a Georgia native, whose work explores fundamental questions of dignity, justice, and human experience.
